book.name: Matyu
book.title: WAI PII EPE MATYUAME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Jisasa Pyao Kumasalanya Kambuiyamino Doko
Jisasame pii dupa pitaka lamaiyoo etapala, baanya disaipolo dupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Pasopa gii doko ipanya yuu gii lapoma silyamo doko nyakamame masilyamino. Gii dokopa Akalinya Ikiningi doko poko itanya pyao yukuina lao amii dupanya kinginya maitana”

content: lea.
Prisa mupapi, Mosesanya loo mana nyepaepi, Juumanya isingi akalipi, dupa prisa mupa Kaeyapasa lenge dokonya anda kamapu dokonya kambuiyami.
Kambuu pituu, dokaitame Jisasa aipa petala waa katao anjoo nyepala pyao kumasemape lao kaitini kutiami.
Kutapala lao pituu, “Endakali dupame pundu yaka lasetamina, nee andake napenge gii dokonya dopa napimanana” leami.
Jisasanya Aiyombanya Wele Kai Lakamaiyamo Doko

Yuu Betani dokonya akali kopetali Saimone lenge dokonya andaka Jisasa baa nee nao petea. Peteamopa enda mendeme penge mendenya wele tunduma pipaeme tumbatae, muni andake pupenge mende minao epea. Ipupala Jisasanya aiyombanya wele doko kai lakamaiya.

Kai lakamaiyamo kandatala, Jisasanya disaipolo dupame imbu kaeyapala lao pituu, “Wele dake salimi lao muni andake nyepala, endakali daa jepae dupa maimualina, aipuma enda dakeme wele dake pyoo nepelyape?” leami.
Dopa leamino doko kandatala Jisasame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Enda dakeme namba-kisa kalai epe mende pilyamona, aipuma nyakamame baanya mona kenda pisakamailyami?
Endakali daa jepae dupa koteaka lao nyakama-pipa katatami. Dopaka doko, namba nyakama-pipa gii longo mende kalya naeyalamano.
Enda dakeme wele tunduma pipae kai lakalamo dokome, nambanya yonge doko malu pipenge dokonya depa lasoo pyakalamo.
Nambame nyakama kiningi langilyo: Wai pii epe dake lao panatami yuu dupa pitakanya, enda dakeme pyomo doko apata lamaitaminopa, endakali dupame baa masetamina”

content: lea.
Judasa Muni Maiyamino Doko
Dokopa 12 disaipolo dutupanya mende, Judasa Iskariota lenge doko, baa prisa mupa dupa kateami dokonya pupala
lao pituu, “Nambame Jisasa nyakamanya kinginya ditoo, nyakamame namba aki mende ditamipi?” lea. Dopa leamopa dokaitame baa silipa muni 30 maiyami.
Gii dokonya pituu, Jisasa dokaitanya kinginya maiyanya Judasame kaitini kutao katea.
Pasopa Nee Doko Neamino Doko

Breta Yisa Pyandala Naeyao Yangapae Nengema, yuu gii tee pyao dokonya, disaipolo dupa Jisasa katea dokonya ipupala baa lamaiyoo, “Pasopa nee doko emba natale, naimame anja depa lakamili lao masilyipi?” leami.
Dopa leaminopa baame lao pituu,

content.text: “Siti dokonya akali mende kalyamona, dokonya nyakama pupape. Pupala akali doko lamaiyoo, ‘Mana Lenge dokome baanya gii doko tengesa petelyamona, Pasopa nee doko baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa embanya andaka namana lelyamona’ lao lamaiyepape”

content: lea.
Dokopa Jisasame leali petala, disaipolo dupame Pasopa nee doko depa leami.
Yuu kuiyala peamopa, Jisasa baa 12 disaipolo dutupa-pipa nee nao peteami.
Nee nao pituu baame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nambame nyakama kiningi langilyo: Nyakamanya mendeme namba yandapipi dupanya kinginya maiyapomona”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa, dokaita mona etete kenda kaeyapala baa tee pyao lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, embame lelyeno doko namba lao lelyepe?” laa-laa peami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasame yanu pyao,

content.text: “Nee disanya kingimi poeyanyoo nao apata pilyamano dakenya mendeme namba yandapipi dupanya kinginya maiyapomo.

Akalinya Ikiningi doko kumala pupengena lao pepa pyapae singi dokonya, dopaka pyaapomo. Dopaka doko, Akalinya Ikiningi doko yandapipi dupanya kinginya maiyapomo akali doko baa koeyalapomo! Akali doko endangimi namandeali doko yaka jialina”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa, yandapipi dupanya kinginya Jisasa maiya akali Judasa dokome baanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Mana Lenge, embame lelyeno doko namba lao lelyepe?” lea. Dopa leamopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Embame latelyenona”

content: lea.
Kamongonya Nee Doko Tee Piamo Doko
Dokaita nee nao pituu, Jisasame breta mende nyepala, Gote yaka pilyino latala konjia. Konjepala disaipolo dupa maiyoo pituu,

content.text: “Dake nambanya yonge dokona, nyoo nalapa”

content: lea.
Dopa latala baame kapo waene peteta mende nyepala, Gote yaka pilyino latala, dokaita maiyoo pituu,

content.text: “Dake nambanya taeyoko doko. Taeyoko kai lelyo dakeme endakali longonya koo dupa kunao nepao, pii enenge mende lao yaki pinya setelyona, nyakama pitakame nyoo nalapa.
Nambame nyakama langilyo: Namba dee waene nala naeyaowaka katao, nambanya Takangenya kingdom dokonya waene enenge doko nyakama-pipa natamana”

content: lea.
Dopa lateamopa, dokaitame wee mende latala kamaka pyakalyiami. Pyakalyetala dokaita Olipimanda peami.
Pitame Jisasa Nakandengena Laapomona Leamo Doko
Dokopa Jisasame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Dapa lao pepa pyapae silyamo: ‘Nambame sipisipi setao katenge doko pyatopa, sipisipi dupa saa latamina’ lapae silyamo. Dopa lapae silyamo dokonya, indupa kuka gii dakepa, namba-kisa kenda ipapomo doko kandatala, nyakama pitaka isa pyakalamino.
Dopaka doko, Goteme namba sakataseta. Dopa petatamopa, nyakama Galali paa naeyataminopa, namba wambao patona”

content: lea.
Dokopa Pitame Jisasa lamaiyoo, “Emba-kisa pita dupa kandatala yangi dupa pitaka isa pyakataminopa, tanga-tangapi namba isa pyakala naeyatona” lea.
Dopa leamopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nambame emba kiningi langilyo: Indupa kuka gii dakepa, yaka pauli pii ene laanya pitamopa, paa tepomasa embame namba nakandengena laapenona”

content: lea.
Dopa leamopa Pitame baa lamaiyoo, “Emba kumate dokonya namba apata kumapenge jetamopapi, nambame emba nakandengena laa naeyalapona” lea. Dokopa disaipolo dupa pitakame dopaka leami.
Gesemani Ee Dokonya Loma Siamo Doko
Dopa lateaminopa, Jisasa baanya disaipolo dupa-pipa yuu Gesemani lenge dokonya peami. Pupala baame dupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Namba omosale loma sala pelyona, nyakama asa pilyepa”

content: lea.
Dokopa Jisasame Pitapi, Sebedi ikiningi dolapopi, dutupa laminao pupala, baa tee pyao mona kenda kaeyapala masepae longo nyia.
Dopa petala Jisasame dutupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nambanya mona doko etete kenda pipya dokome namba kumapenge julumuna, nyakama namba-pipa asa kandao isoo katamana kalyepape”

content: lea.
Dopa latala baa kuki umbisale pao, yuunya tombauli sepala loma soo pituu,

content.text: “Apane, kapo kenda paleta mende nalapo dake embame nyoo nepakapenge jia-kandeno doko, nyoo nepakape. Dopaka doko, nambame masilyo dokonya-kaita napipi. Embame masilyino dokonya-kaita pipi”

content: lea.
Dopa lao loma sepala epeamopa, disaipolo dutupa luu paliu siamino kandatala, baame Pita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakamame awa mendai dokonya namba-pipa kapa pao kandao isoo nakatalamipi?
Nyakamanya moname pyoani kaeyamupa, yongeme papa tambuilyamona, makande pipae dupanya nyakama isa pyakala naeyamana lao loma soo kandao isoo kalyepape”

content: lea.
Dopa latala Jisasa paa lapo pyoo loma sala pea. Loma soo pituu,

content.text: “Apane, kapo kenda paleta dake nambame kaeyala naeyao napenge-tamo doko, embame masilyino dokonya-kaita pina kaeyape”

content: lea.
Loma sepala ipao kandeamopa, disaipolo dutupa lemonguti kaeyapala dee luu paliu siami.
Paliu sina latala, baa paa tepo pyoo loma sala pea. Pupala wamba loma sia dutupaka sia.
Loma sepala, baanya disaipolo dupa kateami dokonya ipupala dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakama koto nyoo luaka paliu silyamipi? Salapape! Gii doko ipatelyamo. Akalinya Ikiningi doko koo pingi endakali dupanya kinginya maiyapomona, naima mona sakatalapa. Namba yandapipi dupanya kinginya maiyapomo akali doko ipatelyamona kanjepa”

content: lea.
Jisasa Anjiamino Doko

Jisasame dopa lao kateamopa, baanya 12 disaipolo dutupanya mende, Judasa lenge doko epea. Endakali kambu andake mende konjuwapi, kolyepepi dupa minao baa-pipa epeami. Dupa prisa mupapi, Juumanya isingi akalipi, dupame epena leaminosa epeami.

Yandapipi dupanya kinginya Jisasa maiya akali dokome kongali mende pyaapona lao endakali baa-pipa epeami dupa lamaiyoo, “Nambame akali mende nunu pyaapo doko baana, nyakamame baa minalapape” lao wamba baame dokaita lamaiya.
Jisasa katea dokonya Judasa tolao pupala lao pituu, “Mana Lenge, kuakama!” lea. Dopa latala baa nunu pia.
Dopa piamopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Kaimii, embame aipa pitoo latala epelyepe?”

content: lea. Dokopa endakali kambu doko Jisasa katea dokonya ipupala, baa minatala anjiami.
Anjiaminopa Jisasa-pipa kateami dupanya mendeme baanya konjuwa doko kolanyetala, prisa mupa dokonya kalai akali dokonya kale doko lyanya nepea.
Dopa piamopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Embanya konjuwa doko palenge andanda dokonya mandi. Konjuwa miningi dupa konjuwameaka kumatami.
Indupa nambanya Takangeme namba nisina lao kyeto joo tee lalu pipupa, baame enjele 72 tausene ita minao etete longo epena lapyalina lao masala naelyepe?
Namba nisina lapuli doko, namba-kisa pipenge dupa dopa pipengena lao Gotenya pii pepa pyapae singi doko aipa petala angi jipyalipi?”

content: lea.
Awa mendai dokonyaka Jisasame endakali kambu dupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Pake nenge mende anjala epele lao nyakamame konjuwapi, kolyepepi dupa minao namba anjala epelyamipi? Nambame koteaka lao lotuu anda nee nyetae kamapu dokonya mana langyoo nyakama-pipa peteo dokopa, nyakamame namba anjala naeyami.
Dopaka doko, propeta dupame pii pepa piami dupa angi jina lao datupa pitaka pilyamona”

content: lea. Dokopa disaipolo dupa pitakame baa yakinatala paka peami.
Jisasa Kotimi Leamino Doko
Dokopa Jisasa anjiami dupame baa laminao, prisa mupa Kaeyapasa katea dokonya peami. Panda dokonya Mosesanya loo mana nyepaepi, Juumanya isingi akalipi, dupa kambu pyao kateami.

Dokopa Pita baa kuki londatili joo Jisasa watao pea. Pupala prisa mupa dokonya anda kamapu dokonya pyakamatala, piami dupa aipa pyoo, pyoo etasilyamipi lao kandatoo latala, yanda singi dupa-pipa petea.

Prisa mupapi, Juumanya isingi akalipi, kanjole kambuingi andake dokonya katenge dupa pitakapi, dupame Jisasa pyao kumasemana latala, akali mendapuame sambo-kisa setao Jisasa kotimi lena latala kutiami.
Kutao nyiamiaka doko, dokaitame tenge angi mende kandao nanyiami. Akali longo mendapu ipupala, baa sambo-kisa setao kotimi leamiaka doko, baa-kisa tenge angi mende kandao nanyiami.

Etao dokonya akali lapoma ipupala lao pituu, “Akali dakeme, ‘Gotenya lotuu anda nee nyetae doko lakyepala, yuu gii tepomanya kapa pao waka mende pitona’ leana” lao, baa sambo-kisa setao kotimi leambi.
Dokopa prisa mupa doko toeya katapala Jisasa lamaiyoo, “Pii lelyambino dupa yanu pyala naelyepe? Emba-kisa tenge setao pii lelyambino dupa sepala, embame aipa lao masilyipi?” lea.

Dopa leamopa Jisasame pii mende nalea. Dokopa prisa mupa dokome baa lamaiyoo, “Gote kataowaka katenge dokome emba kandao kalyamona, embame pii tolao kiningi doko naima langi: Emba Gote Ikiningi Kraisa dokope?” lea.
Dopa leamopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Embame latelyeno. Nambame nyakama dapa langilyo: Akalinya Ikiningi doko, Gote etete kyeto dokonya kingi tolaetena pituu, kaitinya kopa-kisa ipatamopa nyakamame kandatamina”

content: lea.

Dopa leamopa, prisa mupa dokome baanya yonge pee dupa tange minao lapyepala lao pituu, “Baame Gote anda-anda semaiya naeyao pii lelyamo! Aipuma endakali mendapuanya deaka pii nyemana? Baame Gote anda-anda semaiya naeyao pii lelyamo doko nyakamame indupa sepelyamino.
Nyakamame aipa pimana lao masilyamipi?” lea. Dopa leamopa baanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Baa pyao kumasepengena” leami.
Dopa latala, baanya lenge-lyaapinya sopokali tasinya piseta, kimiame pyapa piami. Dokopa akali mendapuame baa kingi kapeme pyao pituu,
“Emba Kraisa daape! Emba pyalumu akali doko, dokona lao propesi piimi naima langi” leami.
Pitame Jisasa Nakandengena Leamo Doko
Pita baa anda kamapu dokonya peteamopa, kalai wanaku mende ipupala baa lamaiyoo, “Emba apata Galali tange Jisasapa kateambina” lea.
Dopa leamopa, Pitame endakali kateami dupanya enombanya tanga lao, “Embame pii lelyeno doko aki mende lelyepe lao nambame masala naelyona” lea.
Dopa latala baa lome kambu dokonya peamopa, kalai wanaku waka mendeme baa kandatala, endakali dosa kateami dupa lamaiyoo, “Akali dake apata Nasarete tange Jisasa dokopa kateambina” lea.
Dokopa Pitame baanya pii dupa kyeto tasalanya, Gotenya kenge doko latala lao pituu, “Akali lelyeno doko namba nakandenge etete daana” lea.
Gii kuki pateamopa, akali dosa kateami dupa ipupala Pita lamaiyoo, “Embanya pii dokome panalumuna, kiningi etete emba akali dutupanya mendeaka-lamona” leami.

Dopa leaminopa Pitame baanya pii dupa kyeto tasalanya Gotenya kenge doko latala lao pituu, “Akali doko namba nakandenge etete daana, sambo lato doko Goteme namba pinana” lea. Dopa lalu piamopa, yaka pauli pii mende lea.
Dokopa Jisasame Pita lamaiya pii datupa Pitame masia:

content.text: “Yaka pauli pii ene laanya pitamopa, paa tepomasa embame namba nakandengena laapenona”

content: lea dutupa masetala, Pita kamaka pyakalyetala, ee lao putukia.
